title: Mrs. Helen Kathleen Or Cattleen Or Katzen-Ellenbojen, M. Barde, Albert Kish, Dr. Rosenberg

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. File No. REGISTRY. No. D 4493 Special Branch S-2. Station 18 Date 15/2/33）
Subject (in full) Further report regarding Mrs. Helen Kathleen, or Cattleen
or Katzen-Ellenbojen.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Everest.

Mrs Helen Kathleen (or Cattleen) returned to Shanghai on
February 5, 1933, on the s.s. "Gange" accompanied by her ten
year old daughter. She resided at the Palace Hotel for a few
days and is now residing at No.9 Rue Pottier.
It is rumoured that Mrs. Kathleen is the mistress of the
Netherlands Minister to China and that she is a divorcee for-
merly known as Mrs. Katzen-Ellenbojen
Other information to the effect that her brother-in-law,
Ellenbojen, was recently convicted in Berlin in connection with
a series of frauds committed there is unconfirmed.
Although Mrs. Kathleen is known to converse freely on
matters relating to Soviet Russia and Communism there is nothing in
her behaviour or associations which might support the supposition
that she is a Communist or a Soviet Agent.

D. S. I. Everest.
D. S. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. 档案号 登记处 编号 D 4493 特别支部 S-2. 第18巡捕房 日期 1933年2月15日）
事由（全称）关于海伦·凯瑟琳（Helen Kathleen），或卡特琳（Cattleen），或卡岑-艾伦博延（Katzen-Ellenbojen）夫人的进一步报告。
由特别支部督察长埃弗里斯特（Everest）撰写并呈送。

海伦·凯瑟琳（或卡特琳）夫人于1933年2月5日乘坐“恒河”号（s.s. "Gange"）轮船返回上海，随行有其十岁的女儿。她在华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）居住了数日，现居于蒲石路（Rue Pottier）9号。
有传言称凯瑟琳夫人是荷兰驻华公使的情妇，且她是一名离异女性，原名卡岑-艾伦博延（Katzen-Ellenbojen）夫人。
另有消息称其姐夫（或妹夫）艾伦博延（Ellenbojen）近期在柏林因涉及一系列欺诈案而被定罪，但该消息未经证实。
尽管众所周知凯瑟琳夫人在谈论有关苏俄和共产主义的话题时畅所欲言，但在其行为或交往中，没有任何迹象支持她是共产党员或苏俄特工的推测。

D. S. I. 埃弗里斯特。
特别支部督察长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 9 /
Special Branch S. 2. Station,
REPORT
Date December 24. 19 32.

Subject (in full) Enquiry regarding Mrs Helen Kathleen (or Catlleen).

Made by [Signature] Forwarded by [Signature]

Discreet enquiries reveal that Mrs Helen Kathleen
arrived in China about January 1932. Since her arrival she
has resided in Peking and is known to be a keen student of
Chinese life in general. Although not regarded as an
experienced journalist she writes on Chinese domestic affairs
and several articles from her pen have been published in Berlin
newspapers. She is an Austrian by birth and is known at the
local German Consulate where she is reputed to be a person of
good standing.

Arriving in Shanghai from Peking on September 22,
1932, she engaged a room (No.405) at the Palace Hotel and
resided there until November 7, when she sailed for Venice
on the Lloyd Triestino steamer "Conte Verdi". Whilst in
Shanghai she conversed freely with hotel clerks and such
people and stated she was proceeding to Europe to bring back
her youngest daughter, age two, who was then in Vienna.

It has been ascertained from the local office of
the Lloyd Triestino that Mrs Kathleen has booked a return
passage on the s.s. "Gange" which is due to leave Venice on
January 11, 1933, and that her present accommodation address
is care of her father - Dr. Rosenberg, Kurfuerstenstrasse 127,
Berlin W-67.

[Signature]
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

事由（全称）关于海伦·凯瑟琳（或卡特琳）夫人的查询。

由 [签名] 撰写，由 [签名] 呈送

谨慎的调查表明，海伦·凯瑟琳夫人于1932年1月左右抵达中国。自抵达以来，她一直居住在北平，并以热衷于研究一般性的中国社会生活而闻名。虽然不被视为经验丰富的记者，但她撰写有关中国国内事务的文章，她的几篇文章已在柏林的报纸上发表。她出生于奥地利，在当地德国领事馆为人所知，据称是一位声誉良好的人士。

她于1932年9月22日从北平抵达上海，在华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）租用了一个房间（405号），并居住至11月7日，随后乘坐意大利劳埃德公司（Lloyd Triestino）的“威尔第伯爵”号（"Conte Verdi"）轮船前往威尼斯。在上海期间，她与酒店职员及此类人员自由交谈，并表示她将前往欧洲接回当时在维也纳的最小的女儿，年仅两岁。

经向当地意大利劳埃德公司办事处核实，凯瑟琳夫人已预订了“恒河”号（s.s. "Gange"）轮船的回程船票，该船定于1933年1月11日离开威尼斯，她目前的通讯地址由其父亲代收——罗森伯格博士（Dr. Rosenberg），柏林 W-67区，选帝侯大街（Kurfuerstenstrasse）127号。

[签名]
特别支部督察长。

My dear Givens,

With further reference to the lady,
you will see by her card, which I enclose, that
I spelled her name wrongly. Although she
went to Europe in the "economic second class,"
which is practically steerage, she gives her
Berlin address as the Eden hotel, which is
the most expensive hotel there.

She said during a subsequent conversation
that she has had an offer from T.V.Soongto
go to Nanking on her return to China and
"reorganise" some of the government departments
by introducing card indexes, a modern filing
system. She expects to take a flat in Shanghai
when this work is finished.

Altogether a curious young woman. .

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

关于那位女士，再作补充说明，从我附上的名片上你可以看到，我把她的名字拼错了。虽然她乘坐的是“经济二等舱”，这实际上相当于统舱，但她给出的柏林地址却是伊甸园酒店（Eden hotel），那是那里最昂贵的酒店。

在随后的一次谈话中，她说宋子文（T.V. Soong）向她发出邀请，在她返回中国时去南京，通过引入卡片索引和现代归档系统来“重组”一些政府部门。她预计在这项工作结束后将在上海租一套公寓。

总之，这是一个奇特的年轻女子。.

（批注：登记。请将手稿归档）

page_data.en:
COPY

S.S. Conte Verde,
Colombo-Bombay,
19th November 1932.

We have a woman passenger in the second class from
Shanghai who is rather interesting. I daresay you know all
about her if she comes within the category of suspects but
as I have heard certain comments abouts her it will do no
harm in any case to bring her to your notice.

The captain tells me that her name is Helen Kathleen,
the latter being her family name, and that she is of Austrian
nationality. I questioned the curious spelling of her family
name but he assures me that it is correct. She is evidently
a Jewess, age uncertain, but probably between 25 and 30,
with brown hair which was originally henna and is now turning
darker at the roots, large eyes which are very far apart, and
she is good looking in a voluptuous way. She speaks French and
German fluently.

The captain said she wished to meet me, and asked if I
would join them after dinner three nights ago. The lady explained
that she had been sitting in the Cathay lounge shortly before
I sailed, in company with M. Barde, Havas' principal correspondent
in Shanghai, whom I met in the Ruhr in 1923. I spoke to Barde
on this occasion, and he apparently told her to try to make
my acquaintance during the voyage. Her reason for doing this,
she said, was that she also did journalistic work. She had
been living in Peking for more than a year and sending
correspondence to the Berlin "Aftenblatt." I found she was
only an amateur who had never done any writing until she came
to China, and it was impossible to get any further information
regarding her presence in Peking, except that she liked China,
and was interested in "the study of economics and political
affairs." She said she had been employed for some time in
"reorganising" the affairs of the Netherlands legations" -
which struck me as a very curious occupation for an Austrian.
She is now going to Europe to remain until February, ostensibly
to bring back her youngest daughter, aged two. She said she
had an older girl aged eight. No mention of a husband.

She brought the conversation around to communism several
times during the two hours the captain and I sat with her.
I had the impression that she wanted to convince me she was
anti-communist, yet was very interested in Russia and in touch
with the movement in China. She mentioned a Russian named,
I think, Kisch or Klsh, a writer, who spent some
months in Peking and Shanghai, and with whom she had been very
friendly. She said she did not agree with Kisch's view that
China was about to "go red". She also said that a certain
book shop in the [illegible], the name of which I cannot
recall, but which [illegible] was a secret rendezvous for
communist agents. She had been there a good many times and met
"interesting" people—I believe Chinese. During her stay
in Shanghai she lived at the Palace Hotel.

[Bottom section heavily obscured/illegible]
I formed my own opinion of the lady which I did not
impart to the captain, but [illegible] that [illegible]
called her "Helen White". I asked why. He said it was because
she [illegible] like many people in China [illegible]
[illegible] the best propaganda.

副本

“威尔第伯爵”号轮船（S.S. Conte Verde），
科伦坡至孟买航段，
1932年11月19日。

我们船上有一位从上海来的二等舱女乘客，颇为有趣。如果她属于嫌疑人类别，我想你对她应该已有所了解，但既然我听到了一些关于她的议论，无论如何，提请你注意并无害处。

船长告诉我，她的名字叫海伦·凯瑟琳（Helen Kathleen），后者是她的姓氏，她是奥地利国籍。我对她姓氏的奇特拼写提出了疑问，但他向我保证这是正确的。她显然是一位犹太女性，年龄不详，但可能在25至30岁之间，留着棕色头发，最初染过指甲花红（henna），现在发根颜色变深，双眼间距很大，长相性感迷人。她能流利地说法语和德语。

船长说她希望见我，并询问我是否愿意在前天晚上饭后加入他们。这位女士解释说，在我启航前不久，她曾与哈瓦斯通讯社（Havas）驻上海首席记者巴尔德先生（M. Barde）一起坐在华懋饭店的大厅里，我曾在1923年于鲁尔区见过巴尔德。我当时与巴尔德交谈过，他显然告诉她要在航行途中设法与我结识。她说她这样做的原因是她也从事新闻工作。她在北平居住了一年多，并向柏林的《晚报》（"Aftenblatt"）发送通讯稿件。我发现她只是一个业余爱好者，在来中国之前从未进行过任何写作，除了她喜欢中国，并对“经济学和政治事务的研究”感兴趣之外，无法获得关于她在北平活动的更多信息。她说她受雇一段时间“重组”荷兰公使馆的事务——这对一个奥地利人来说似乎是一种非常奇特的职业。她现在前往欧洲，计划停留至二月，表面上是为了接回她两岁的最小女儿。她说她还有一个八岁的大女儿。未提及丈夫。

在船长和我与她共处的两个小时里，她几次将话题引向共产主义。给我的印象是，她想让我相信她是反共产主义的，但她对俄国非常感兴趣，并与中国的运动保持联系。她提到了一位名叫基施（Kisch）或克尔什（Klsh）（我想是这个名字）的俄国作家，他在北平和上海待了几个月，她与他关系非常密切。她说她不同意基施认为中国即将“变红”的观点。她还说，在[原文不清]有一家书店，名字我记不起来了，但[原文不清]是共产主义特工的秘密接头地点。她去过那里很多次，并遇到了“有趣”的人——我相信是中国人。她在上海期间住在华懋饭店。

[底部部分严重遮挡/原文不清]
我对这位女士形成了自己的看法，但我没有告诉船长，但[原文不清]称她为“海伦·怀特”（Helen White）。我问为什么。他说这是因为她[原文不清]像在中国的许多人一样[原文不清][原文不清]最好的宣传。
